exclusions: Concern, advice, a stated wish, an unacted plan, ordinary proximity, or an action that does not satisfy the preserved protection, rescue, escape, treatment, or intervention threshold does not count.
A coincidental outcome, self-rescue, unrelated attack, or proxy intervention does not count for the named protector unless the preserved condition explicitly names participation in an operation.
An off-screen report, recap, mention, dream, vision, memory, prediction, promotional image, or hypothetical danger or rescue does not count.
families.title_review_note: Each title honestly names a concrete protection, rescue, escape, treatment, or intervention; settlement requires the preserved actor, beneficiary, danger, intent, and causal threshold.
